headline: Tax refunds, a Yale opioid case manager funding deal, and OpenGov and Catalis software agreements.
summary: Several tax refunds for property and motor vehicle taxes are on the list. Other items include appointments to boards and commissions and a grant from the Friends of the Library.
items: Plant donation from Eli's Garden of Healing for DeNicola Park
Reappointment of Mike Doyle to Veterans Commission
Reappointment of Reginald Jackson to Veterans Commission
Agreement with Vertosoft for OpenGov software and services
Agreement with Catalis Public Works & Citizen Engagement, LLC for Hamden Police Department
Interdepartmental transfer of 2025-2026 fiscal year budget for Mayor's Office, Public Works, and Finance
Funding support agreement with Yale University for an opioid case manager
Appointment of board and commission members recommended by Mayor Sendroff
Refund of property taxes collected between 07/01/2026 and 06/30/2027
Refund of property and motor vehicle taxes collected prior to 07/01/2026
Refund of motor vehicle taxes collected between 07/01/2026 and 06/30/2027
Committee of the Whole: grant from the Friends of the Library
location: Memorial Town Hall, 2372 Whitney Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518
